Stand up observability as a platform standard across all tiers, including distributed tracing, metrics, structured logging, and SLOs, so failures are diagnosable across a distributed transaction and not just within one service.

Architecting for agentic workflows- Experience designing LLM-facing tool/agent surfaces with guardrails around inputs, tokens, and downstream system protection. Containers- Docker and a container orchestration/runtime platform in production. Preferred Qualifications Amazon Redshift and/or SageMaker. Change data capture at scale, with an appreciation for why near-real-time capture off a transactional system of record is hard. Stakeholder Partnership & Platform Thinking – Collaborating with business leaders to translate needs into reusable, self-service integration capabilities serving both systems of record and digital products.
